run.target: APP-01 QDP foundation vertical slice plus required L1 contracts
run.commit: core 9efdc7f4 + plugin 36067e03 with uncommitted worktree changes

groups.title: Shared platform contracts required by QDP

rows.action: Create, read and mutate dynamic mt_* records with a platform-owned row_version
rows.assertion: Fresh and migrated mt_* tables expose row_version; relevant mutations advance it and stale command versions are rejected.

rows.action: Resolve command target and payload templates from the clicked detail record during promptUpload
rows.assertion: The browser-supplied record pid reaches both targetRecordPid and crm_qdp_customer_request_id; the command creates R0003.
rows.vision_check: R0003, revision 3, passed and qdp-browser-upload.csv are visible in QDP release history.

rows.action: Release qualified routed PCBA demand into an immutable QDP revision
rows.assertion: The real HTTP journey authenticates, validates the source/qualification/version, retains and hashes the file, creates revisions, links the sidecar and writes command audit rows.

rows.action: Reject missing/stale version, missing file, target mismatch, unqualified demand and non-command writer attempts
rows.assertion: All named negative paths return the expected 400/409 response and do not create a QDP revision.

rows.action: Replay the same client identity and conflict on changed intent
rows.assertion: Same intent returns the same revision, changed intent returns 409, and a new identity creates the next revision.

groups.title: QDP browser entry and visible feedback

rows.action: Open Customer Demand from the product menu, select the true-stack record and inspect release history
rows.assertion: The real route/menu, record detail, Release QDP action and immutable history render without raw-code leakage in the primary user path.
rows.vision_check: Customer Demand list and QDP detail/history were visually inspected at the runtime viewport.

rows.action: Upload a CSV through Release QDP and observe the persisted next revision
rows.assertion: The UI action uploads a real file, invokes crm:release_qdp and renders R0003 from PostgreSQL readback.
rows.vision_check: R0003 and qdp-browser-upload.csv are visibly present after the action.

rows.action: Exercise stale-row, no-permission and cross-tenant denial through browser entrypoints
rows.assertion: The browser must show precise 409/403 feedback and must not leak the target or create a revision.

groups.title: North-star capabilities outside this foundation slice

rows.action: Bind customer confirmation to Requirement Version and file-package hash before release
rows.assertion: AC-APP01-003 and full GT-D04 are implemented.

rows.action: Review version diff, Pack Set, downstream impact, approved exceptions and supersession in a QDP Release Center
rows.assertion: UX-D08 is complete rather than a one-file foundation action.

rows.action: Keep UI, API, batch, deep-link and Agent Tool authorization/state behavior equivalent
rows.assertion: AC-APP01-006 is complete across every caller.
